title: Part
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero degrees in all axes and a translation vector of [0.1166, 0.3801, -0.0557]. On the first face, draw a two-dimensional sketch consisting of a rectangular loop. Start by drawing the first line from the origin (0.0, 0.0) to (0.086, 0.0), then draw the second line from (0.086, 0.0) to (0.086, 0.0648), followed by the third line from (0.086, 0.0648) to (0.0, 0.0648), and finally the fourth line from (0.0, 0.0648) back to the origin. Apply a scaling factor of 0.086 to the entire two-dimensional sketch. Rotate the scaled two-dimensional sketch using the same Euler angles as the coordinate system and translate it using the same translation vector. Extrude the transformed two-dimensional sketch along its normal by 0.2198 units, ensuring no extrusion occurs in the opposite direction. Create a new solid body from the extruded shape. The final dimensions of the rectangular base with rounded edges are 0.08601593367446077 units in length, 0.06477103439341925 units in width, and 0.2198166979726666 units in height.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define the sketch
sketch = cq.Workplane("XY").moveTo(0, 0).lineTo(0.086, 0).lineTo(0.086, 0.0648).lineTo(0, 0.0648).close()

# Extrude the sketch
extruded = sketch.extrude(0.2198)

# Apply the coordinate system transformation
transformed = extruded.translate((0.1166, 0.3801, -0.0557))

# Final model
r = transformed

import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create a sketch on the XY plane
r = r.moveTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.086, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.086, 0.0648) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.0648) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .close()

# Extrude the sketch to create a rectangular prism
r = r.extrude(0.2198)

# Translate the object to the specified position
r = r.translate((0.0, 0.0, 0.2198))
